article.headline: Scores from last Night: South Pontotoc sweeps Hickory Flat; Starkville wins at Brandon
article.html:
South Pontotoc swept its varsity basketball visit to Hickory Flat on Monday, November 16, with the girls staying unbeaten in a 65-23 win and the boys winning 63-34. Starkville added a 4-1 boys soccer victory at Brandon, moving above an even record, while Forrest County Agricultural earned home wins in boys basketball and girls soccer.

Girls basketball: South Pontotoc keeps its perfect start

South Pontotoc’s girls beat Hickory Flat 65-23 and are listed at 5-0 on the completed matchup page. Hickory Flat’s updated record is 3-3. The Cougars established control early: the posted box score gives them a 21-5 first quarter and a 20-8 second quarter, putting the home team under pressure before halftime.

The unbeaten start that led Monday’s Games To Watch preview remained intact. South Pontotoc continued to limit Hickory Flat after the break, with the Rebels scoring eight points in the third quarter and two in the fourth. The result extended the Cougars’ perfect opening while bringing Hickory Flat level in wins and losses.

Boys basketball: Cougars finish the sweep; Aggies edge Pearl River Central

South Pontotoc’s boys won 63-34 at Hickory Flat to reach a listed 3-2 record, with the Rebels at 1-5. The opening quarter was close at 13-11, but South Pontotoc won the second quarter 13-4 to create separation. The Cougars also finished strongly, outscoring Hickory Flat 22-9 in the fourth. Their win completed the basketball sweep and put them above an even record.

Forrest County Agricultural held off visiting Pearl River Central 41-39 in boys basketball. Both teams are listed at 1-2 after the nonconference game. The narrow result gave the Aggies their first listed victory, with the Blue Devils leaving Brooklyn with the same overall record as their hosts.

Wheeler won 81-69 at Ashland and is listed at 2-1, while Ashland is listed at 0-5. The Eagles emerged from the road game with a winning record; the Blue Devils are still seeking their first listed victory.

Boys soccer: Starkville takes charge at Brandon

Starkville won its road soccer match at Brandon 4-1 and is listed at 4-3, while Brandon is listed at 2-4-1. The posted box score shows the Yellowjackets leading 2-0 at halftime and adding two more goals after the break, with Brandon scoring once in the second half. Starkville paired a strong opening half with further scoring to secure the nonconference win.

Girls soccer: Forrest County Agricultural makes its goal stand

Forrest County Agricultural’s girls beat visiting Loyd Star 1-0, with the completed matchup listing the Aggies at 4-1 and the Hornets at 5-3. The box score credits Forrest County Agricultural with a first-half goal and shows a scoreless second half. That opening goal proved enough for a shutout win, giving the Aggies another result to build on in their winning start.
